bridgeRouteRisk.summary: XAGm has independent native issuer-liability deployments on Ethereum and Sui; those native mint controls remain in Mint Authority. Its active cross-chain transfer overlay is LayerZero V2: the Ethereum MTokenMessenger burns source XAGm and can mint destination XAGm, while the Sui messenger state exposes the XAGm MessengerCap and peer/admin capabilities. This is an external-validated-network bridge tier; unresolved DVN/executor, Sui peer-byte, and route-limit reads remain explicit.
